name: Copper
description: Copper is a globally traded industrial metal shaped by mine output, smelter capacity, inventories, freight constraints, construction, and electrical-equipment demand.

benchmark.name: COMEX Copper futures
benchmark.delayPolicy: Provider-defined; use the displayed as-of timestamp.
benchmark.caveat: This futures quote is a market proxy, not a physical spot assessment.

marketContext: Read the futures benchmark beside mine disruptions, treatment charges, exchange inventories, freight conditions, and demand from construction and electrical equipment. Those indicators move on different schedules. A quote can react before a physical shortage is documented, or move for macro reasons while the supply chain remains unchanged.
